description.message: One-click export of cookies from a logged-in tab to the QD framework via postMessage, no manual copy needed.

optionsHostsHelp.message: URLs of QD instances (one per line). The extension only injects its export button on these origins. e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8923 or https://qd.example.com

confirmMessage.message: Export cookies from "$SITE$" to the current page ($ORIGIN$)?

errorEmpty.message: No cookies returned. Have you logged into the target site?

errorContext.message: Extension context invalidated, please reload the page.
